lines.zh: 我踩着轻缓的步子，杖尖点地。
lines.en: I walk unhurriedly, my staff tapping the ground.

lines.zh: 这点路，慢慢走才有味道。
lines.en: A walk like this is best taken slowly.

lines.zh: 我绕过柱子，顺带看看风景。
lines.en: I round the pillar and take in the view.
The stone in this corridor is rather nice.

lines.zh: 我一步不带响动，却已经到你身边。
lines.en: My steps make no sound, yet here I am beside you.
Walking fast makes one miss good things.

lines.zh: 我稍微飘起来一点，省力。
lines.en: I float up slightly; it saves effort.
The staff in my hand is simply a habit.
I take a turn about the temple.

lines.zh: 地上的影子都没跟上我。
lines.en: Even my shadow lags behind me.
I should go check that pot of soup.

lines.zh: 步子轻，是因为心里没事。
lines.en: My step is light because my mind is clear.

lines.zh: 我走到台阶边，停了一下。
lines.en: I reach the steps and pause.

lines.zh: 这一层太高，直接就上去了。
lines.en: This floor is high; I simply go up.
I turn my cup slowly in my hands.

lines.zh: 这时候更适合吃点甜的。
lines.en: This is a good time for something sweet.
I smile and say nothing.

lines.zh: 杖立在旁边，也站得很直。
lines.en: The staff stands beside me, equally straight.
Clouds drift past my feet.

lines.zh: 你的气息，我听得很清楚。
lines.en: I hear your energy quite clearly.

lines.zh: 万物都有它自己的节奏。
lines.en: Everything has its own rhythm.
I am waiting for an interesting question.
I bow my head as if dozing.
With tea in hand, I watch you train.
No hurry; a whole day is long.

lines.zh: 我的杖尖有一搭没一搭地点着地。
lines.en: My staff taps the ground now and then.
Standing still is a form of practice too.
I can smell the kitchen from here.
You look like you have many questions.
Sit first; talking while standing tires the legs.
You train well — only too hastily.

lines.zh: 我从你的站姿里看出很多。
lines.en: Your stance tells me a great deal.
Do not fear me; I rarely lift a hand.
Whatever you wish to learn, I likely know it.

lines.zh: 先问对的问题，再谈修行。
lines.en: Ask the right question before we speak of training.
The energy about you is somewhat disordered.

lines.zh: 我看着你，像看着一株小苗。
lines.en: I regard you as one regards a small sprout.

lines.zh: 慢一点，你又会错过什么。
lines.en: Slow down, or you will miss something again.
Your gaze should settle; your breath should deepen.
You came at a good time; the soup is ready.
I am smiling, and not at you.

lines.zh: 你的潜力比你自己以为的大。
lines.en: Your potential is greater than you believe.
Ask away; I am listening.

lines.zh: 维斯站着，杖尖点了点地。
lines.en: Whis taps his staff on the ground.
Oh, that actually stings a little.
I step back half a pace, still smiling.
Your force is greater than last time.

lines.zh: 我理了理被弄皱的衣角。
lines.en: I smooth my rumpled hem.
It seems I was too relaxed.

lines.zh: 这一下我记住了，神殿的柱子也记。
lines.en: I will remember that blow, and so will the temple pillars.

lines.zh: 我呼出一口气，稳住身形。
lines.en: I breathe out and steady myself.
Do not take this for victory.
The staff nearly flew, I gripped it tight.
It hurts, but it is far too early.
Sweets? You have excellent taste.
Just set it on the table, thank you.
I taste it. Mmm, not bad.
This flavor is more interesting than training.
Patience; let it cool a moment.
Will you have a portion too?

lines.zh: 我吃东西从不狼吞虎咽。
lines.en: I never wolf my food down.
This mouthful deserves slow savoring.
The nose is more honest than the eyes.
We shall discuss business after eating.
Oh, pardon me — you bumped into me.
You walk a little too quickly.
I yield half a step and you pass.
Not even my hem is disturbed.
Steady yourself; do not fall.

lines.zh: 碰到我，你会觉得像碰到棉花。
lines.en: Bumping me feels like bumping cotton.
No harm done. Carry on.
This corridor is actually quite wide.

lines.zh: 我侧身让路，你该说声谢谢。
lines.en: I step aside; you might say thank you.
Mind your feet next time.

lines.zh: 对练？我很乐意，但请轻一点。
lines.en: A spar? Gladly — but be gentle.

lines.zh: 你的节奏慢下来了，很好。
lines.en: Your rhythm has slowed. Good.
I shall demonstrate once; watch closely.

lines.zh: 修行不必着急，日子还长。
lines.en: There is no rush in training; days are long.
Your energy is beginning to flow evenly.

lines.zh: 这样练下去，你会进步的。
lines.en: Keep this up and you will improve.

lines.zh: 我教你一个呼吸的法子。
lines.en: I will teach you a way of breathing.
Do not knock my staff crooked.
Rest a moment and drink something.
We shall stop here for today.
I pick it up between two fingers and look.
This is rather interesting.
I set it back where it belongs.
The dessert is mine; the rest is yours.
Not valuable, but cleverly made.

lines.zh: 我袖子里能装很多东西。
lines.en: My sleeve holds a great many things.
This smells like something from the kitchen.
I weigh it; heavier than it looks.
Keep it; do not leave it lying about.
I take up my staff and pinch it along.
Very well, let us practice.

lines.zh: 你的意图我早看出来了。
lines.en: I saw your intention some time ago.
Watch my staff.
I shall keep the force very low.

lines.zh: 这一下会疼，但不会伤你。
lines.en: This will sting, but not harm you.
Come, make your move.
I do not dodge; I only block.
This is a lesson, not a duel to the death.
Your footing has a gap again.

lines.zh: 我准备笑着结束这一回合。
lines.en: I intend to end this round smiling.
Your weight is on the right.
I stand here only to watch.
When my staff lifts, you should retreat.
Do not be fooled by my smile.
That step was too fast; I saw it.
I wait for you to find your own flaw.
If your breath is uneven, your moves fall apart.
Lower your angle a little and it is right.
I barely moved; I merely leaned aside.
Three more exchanges and you will stop.
A light tap of my staff — enough.
I held back seven parts of that.
Your shoulder was tapped.
Not painful, was it? Then again.

lines.zh: 我抬手一挡，你的拳就偏了。
lines.en: I raise a hand and your fist slides away.
You are spending your strength in the wrong place.
Stand firm; that was a reminder.
Keep the motion clean — no excess.
I lower my staff with a smile, and you are down.
That is enough for today. Go and think.

lines.zh: 我一直在这里，只是你没抬头。
lines.en: I have been here; you simply did not look up.
I land lightly before you.
Days at the temple are always slow.

lines.zh: 我端着杯子出来迎接你。
lines.en: I come out to greet you with a cup in hand.
The breeze on this floor is pleasant.
I knew of your arrival well in advance.
I incline my head slightly, which counts as a bow.

lines.zh: 别惊讶，我向来这样出现。
lines.en: Do not be startled; I always appear like this.
It is quiet here, good for talking.
The tea is just brewed; you came at the right time.

lines.zh: 火烧过来，我拂了拂袖子。
lines.en: Fire comes and I brush my sleeve.
These old bones are fine.
Water is stifling; I am not used to it.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的杯子震碎了。
lines.en: The blast shattered my cup.

lines.zh: 我接住了箭，还是擦破了皮。
lines.en: I caught the arrow, but it grazed me.
This force feels somewhat familiar.
I cannot teach on an empty stomach.
Lightning falls and I raise a hand against it.
The ground is gone; I remain unruffled.
